title: Brightness levels randomly changing every second after using Power Display
author: basel-m
summary: Power Display intermittently oscillates brightness once per second, and a contributor already requested an immediate post-reproduction bug report; the reporter has not replied.

status.label: Waiting on intermittent-failure diagnostics
status.detail: The symptom is intermittent and the latest upstream request is /bugreport captured at the next occurrence.

next_action.label: Wait for recurrence evidence
next_action.reason: The author owes diagnostics from the next occurrence; do not expose a duplicate request.

judgment.rationale: The symptom is credible but intermittent, and the contributor /bugreport request remains unanswered.
evidence: Brightness alternates between two levels about once per second.
The behavior happened twice in a month while connected to power despite a battery-only setting.
No later author response, archive, assignee, duplicate, or linked fix exists.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the reporter to capture the next occurrence with a fresh diagnostic archive.

issue_context.summary: An intermittent Power Display loop appears to compete over brightness state, but it has not been captured in logs.
known_information: Windows 11 Enterprise 24H2 build 26100.8893 and PowerToys 0.100.2 are reported.
PowerToys was installed from Software Center and Power Display was enabled.
The content-based brightness setting is On Battery Only, but the symptom was observed while plugged in.
The Windows and Power Display brightness sliders visibly jump between two levels every second during the issue.
The issue is intermittent, has no ZIP, no assignee, and no linked fix.
inferences: Two control paths may be alternating brightness writes, but Power Display, Windows adaptive brightness, OEM software, hardware, and policy remain possible without logs.
issue_context.analysis: The existing /bugreport request is still the right next step because timing and writer evidence are needed from an intermittent occurrence. A second request would not add a new maintainer action.
initial_investigation: Forced 2026-09-02 pass read the complete issue body, both comments, labels, empty assignee list, and timeline links; no linked work appeared.
Reviewed PowerDisplay module layout and CLI/settings surfaces enough to confirm brightness control ownership exists, but no issue-specific code path can be selected without logs.
The latest substantive upstream action remains the contributor /bugreport request.

information_gaps.why_needed: Determines whether Power Display is issuing repeated brightness writes or reacting to an external source.
information_gaps.information: A fresh diagnostic archive captured during or immediately after the brightness oscillation.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: At the next occurrence, add a comment containing /bugreport immediately and attach the generated ZIP.
